config.title: Wigglesworth — Official Applications And Support
config.subtitle: Three ways in. Pick the role that fits you and send one honest application.
config.announcement: Moderator Applications CLOSED, Opening back at 150 members...
config.rules: • Must be 13+• One role per application — pick the closest fit• Be honest — lying = instant deny• Spamming applications = blacklist

faq.a: Anyone 13 or older. No experience needed for Moderator — attitude matters more.

faq.q: How long until I hear back?
faq.a: Usually in a about a few days or hours, depending if you ping @mightbeqntmz. Check your decision above with your Application ID given to you after submitting your application.

faq.q: Can I apply for two roles?
faq.a: Yes — one application per role. Pick the closest fit first.
Lying, copied answers, blank fields, or applying twice to skip the queue.

applicationTypes.name: Moderator
applicationTypes.blurb: Keep chat clean, enforce the rules, help players.
applicationTypes.intro: Moderators keep the community safe and welcoming. Only apply here if that is the role you want.

questions.label: Timezone / Availability (being able to be used, obtained, or reached when needed)
Why do you want to be Moderator?
Someone is spamming in chat. What do you do?
Have you ever been banned? If so, why?

applicationTypes.name: Content Creator
applicationTypes.blurb: Make videos and streams that grow the community.
applicationTypes.intro: Creators represent Wigglesworth on their channels. Apply here with your best work.

questions.label: What kind of content do you make?
Any strikes or bans on your channels? Be honest

applicationTypes.name: Developer
applicationTypes.blurb: Build the games, bots, and tools players use.
applicationTypes.intro: Developers ship real things for players. Show us what you have built.

questions.label: A game-breaking bug appears an hour before an event, or we are in desperate need of an item to be made. What do you do?
Do you prefer solo or team work?
